sourceAuthority: T4032-AB Payroll Deductions Tables — Alberta 2026 + T4127 Alberta Table 8.1
verificationNote: Alberta Table 8.1 (annualised) 2026 V (rate) and KP (bracket constant) values as installed in H1/H2 packages. Also asserts Alberta BPA and the K5P block (§H).

expected.notes: Alberta BPA + first-bracket rate used across the K1P and K2P (BASE CPP + EI) credit factors. K3P = 0 for the MVP. K4P is statutorily not applicable. K2AP is NOT a T4127 factor (Spectre-internal helper only).

expected.packageEquivalent: K5P = max(0, ((K1P + K2P) - threshold) × (supplementalRate / baseRate)) where 0.02 / 0.08 = 0.25
expected.sourceCitation: T4127 122nd Edition (§Alberta, K5P). H2 (123rd Edition) inherits — Alberta K5P is NOT identified as changed effective July 1, 2026.
expected.notes: Payroll-3B-5B-1d CORRECTION: threshold is $4,896.00 (verified against T4127 122nd Edition), NOT the earlier $4,800 draft. Package stores threshold + supplementalRate + baseRate separately so the CRA relationship stays auditable — no opaque precomputed coefficient.
